name: system_info
description: Read system information from a device.

name: health_snapshot
description: Read-only health snapshot of a device: CPU usage and load, memory and swap, disks, network counters, and the top processes by CPU and memory. Includes observedAt and limitations.

name: log_query
description: Read-only, bounded log search on a device, newest first. source 'journal' (Linux systemd journal: since_minutes window, unit, level) or 'file' (tail of a log file inside the allowed roots). Filters: level (error|warning|info|debug, default info), pattern (case-insensitive regex), limit (1-1000, default 100). Repeated messages are grouped; secrets are masked.

unit.description: systemd unit for source 'journal', e.g. ssh.service.

name: policy_info
description: Read agent-enforced allowed directories and resource limits. Read-only.

name: fs_list
description: List a directory inside an agent allowlisted root.

name: fs_stat
description: Read file or directory metadata.

name: fs_read
description: Read a file as UTF-8 text or base64 payload.

name: fs_read_lines
description: Read a page of UTF-8 lines. offset_lines is zero-based; negative offsets count back from end of file. Maximum 1000 lines and 256 KiB of output.

name: image_inspect
description: Read PNG/JPEG/GIF or extended WebP dimensions and file metadata from headers only. Does not decode pixels or generate a preview. 32 MiB file limit; 256 KiB header scan.

name: docx_inspect
description: Inspect DOCX paragraph/table counts without loading external resources or executing macros. Read-only, 16 MiB ZIP and 8 MiB document XML limits.

name: docx_read_paragraphs
description: Read up to 100 DOCX paragraphs as structured, bounded text. Offset is zero-based; content in tables is included.

name: docx_read_table
description: Read up to 50 rows of a DOCX table, max 20 cells per row; table_index and offset_rows are zero-based.

name: pdf_read
description: Read the text layer of up to 20 PDF pages. start_page is 1-based (default 1); a negative value counts from the end (-1 is the last page). page_count defaults to 5. Scanned pages without a text layer return empty text.

name: xlsx_inspect
description: List worksheets in an XLSX/XLSM workbook without running macros. Read-only; compressed limit 16 MiB, expanded ZIP limit 64 MiB.

name: xlsx_read_range
description: Read up to 50 rows by 20 columns from one worksheet, using 1-based coordinates. Does not evaluate formulas or execute macros.

name: xlsx_find
description: Search cached cell values in XLSX/XLSM, without evaluating formulas. Bounded to 50,000 cells, 30 sheets, and 100 matches.

name: xlsx_write_cells
description: Write up to 100 string/number/boolean cells to a NEW XLSX output file without overwriting the original. Existing XLSM files cannot be edited. Optional SHA-256 precondition prevents stale writes.

name: fs_write
description: Write base64-encoded bytes to an allowlisted file. Optional expected_sha256 rejects stale content; with_undo snapshots an existing regular file (max 4 MiB) for guarded restoration.

name: fs_append
description: Append base64-encoded bytes to an allowlisted file. Optional expected_sha256 guards stale appends; with_undo atomically appends to an existing regular file (max 4 MiB) and creates a guarded snapshot.

name: fs_mkdir
description: Create a directory.

name: fs_delete
description: Delete a file or directory. HIGH risk. Optional expected_sha256 deletes a regular file only if its content is unchanged (atomic on Linux/macOS). Omit approval_token to create a human approval request, then retry after approval.

name: fs_move
description: Move or rename a file/directory inside the agent allowlisted roots. Destination must not already exist.

name: fs_tree
description: Recursively list a bounded directory tree without following symlinks.

name: fs_search
description: Search file and directory names recursively inside an allowlisted root.

name: text_search
description: Search literal text recursively in bounded UTF-8 files inside an allowlisted root.

name: fs_replace
description: Perform a guarded UTF-8 search/replace edit. By default the search must match exactly once.

name: fs_versions
description: List at most eight persistent undo snapshots for an allowlisted file.

name: fs_undo
description: Restore a prior fs_replace snapshot only when the current SHA-256 matches. Consumes the snapshot on success.

name: process_exec
description: Execute a shell command. HIGH risk. Omit approval_token to create a human approval request, then retry after approval.

name: process_list
description: List visible processes.

name: process_kill
description: Terminate a process. HIGH risk. Omit approval_token to create a human approval request, then retry after approval.

name: task_start
description: Start a persistent background command task. The task survives AI/gateway disconnects while the agent process remains alive. HIGH risk; omit approval_token to request human approval.

name: task_status
description: Read status and retained output of a persistent background task.

name: task_cancel
description: Cancel a persistent background task. HIGH risk; omit approval_token to request human approval.

name: task_list
description: List retained persistent background tasks so a reconnected AI client can recover task ids.

name: terminal_start
description: Start a persistent PTY session. HIGH risk; omit approval_token to request human approval.

name: terminal_input
description: Write at most 256 KiB of decoded bytes to an existing PTY session.

name: terminal_read
description: Read buffered PTY output.

name: terminal_read_page
description: Read non-consuming retained PTY history independently of terminal_read. Positive offset_bytes is an absolute output byte cursor; negative reads from the end. Results report retainedStartBytes and truncatedBeforeOffset when the 1 MiB history cap evicts data.

name: terminal_resize
description: Resize a PTY session.

name: terminal_stop
description: Stop a PTY session. HIGH risk; omit approval_token to request human approval.

name: terminal_list
description: List persistent PTY sessions, process ids and retained output sizes.

name: read_file
description: Desktop Commander compatible: read a text file. With offset/length, reads a line range (zero-based offset; negative counts from the end). For .pdf files, offset/length are pages (max 20).

name: read_multiple_files
description: Desktop Commander compatible: read up to ten files.

name: write_file
description: Desktop Commander compatible: write UTF-8 text. mode 'rewrite' (default) replaces the file, 'append' appends.

name: list_directory
description: Desktop Commander compatible: list a directory.

name: create_directory
description: Desktop Commander compatible: create a directory (with parents).

name: move_file
description: Desktop Commander compatible: move or rename a file or directory.

name: get_file_info
description: Desktop Commander compatible: file or directory metadata.

name: edit_block
description: Desktop Commander compatible surgical edit: replace old_string with new_string. Exact match first; if absent, a whitespace-tolerant match is used only when it is unique. expected_replacements (default 1) must equal the number of matches. The write is guarded by the file's SHA-256, so a concurrent change is never overwritten.
